summary: Well-structured test suite with comprehensive coverage of core requirements. Unit tests thoroughly cover glob patterns (**, *, ?), multiple labels, priority ordering, deduplication, and error handling. Workflow tests validate YAML structure, actionlint compliance, and integration via act. Strengths: clear separation of unit/workflow tests, robust fixture management, proper setup/teardown, multiple error scenarios, and actual CI pipeline validation. Gaps: only 3 act integration test cases (somewhat limited scope), missing edge cases like special characters in filenames, case sensitivity behavior, and tests for empty patterns/labels despite code handling them. No explicit tests for very long paths or duplicate rules. Would effectively catch most regressions for the core label assignment logic.
